name: EPlay
welcome: Welcome to **EPlay**, the music player for the Atari Falcon. It plays MP3 on the Falcon's DSP, or through a SoundPool FDI, and WAV and AIFF, from a list of files, folders and playlists, one after another; the music goes on while you work in its dialogs and menus.

window.title: The window
items: The info line: what EPlay is doing, and the output's rate.
What plays: its album art, title and artist, bit rate and rate.
Previous, Play/Pause and Next; where it plays (FDI, DSP or DMA) beside them.
The position bar: click or drag on it to go there.
The volume: click or drag, or + and -.
The list: a double click or Return plays a row.
